solution.title: iOS/iPadOS Enterprise SSO App Extension for Corporate-Owned iPhones (Microsoft Enterprise SSO Plug-in via Intune)

products.name: iOS/iPadOS Enterprise SSO App Extension for Corporate-Owned iPhones (Microsoft Enterprise SSO Plug-in via Intune) — Commercial
products.short_description: Deploy the Microsoft Enterprise SSO plug-in as an Extensible SSO app extension on corporate iPhones via Intune — silent shared auth to Entra-secured apps and Safari, with one key that covers every managed app — pilot-first. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Stop the sign-in prompts and repeat MFA on corporate iPhones

Users on corporate iPhones still get repeated sign-in prompts — and repeated MFA — in apps and Safari because the Enterprise SSO app extension isn't deployed. This solution deploys the Microsoft Enterprise SSO plug-in as an Apple Extensible SSO app extension (hosted in Microsoft Authenticator) via Intune on corporate-owned, enrolled iPhones/iPads — delivering silent, shared authentication to Entra-secured apps and Safari — deployed pilot-first and rollback-ready.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — how Apple's Extensible SSO (redirect/credential types) and the Microsoft Enterprise SSO plug-in work on iOS (hosted in Microsoft Authenticator, not Company Portal), and how this differs from the macOS product and the shared-device / dual-device solutions.
  • Requirements Guide — prerequisites (Intune enrollment, Microsoft Authenticator, Entra config, Safari/app support, a pilot group) with how to verify/implement each.
  • Implementation Guide — exact steps to build the named Device-features SSO app-extension profile (Microsoft Entra ID type), enable SSO for all managed apps, deploy, prime the broker, validate silent SSO, then pilot and expand.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — SSO-extension discovery, per-device applied-state validation, an SSO coverage report, safe remediation of missing/mis-scoped profiles, and a target-group builder.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides (extension active, apps/Safari SSO silently, repeat-MFA fixes) plus Best Practices for managed-app coverage and URL scoping.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Silent, shared sign-in to Entra apps and Safari across every corporate iPhone — the Enterprise SSO app extension deployed and proven on a pilot before you scale.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • IOSSSOEXT-Discovery.ps1 — tenant readiness check for the iOS Enterprise SSO app extension
    • IOSSSOEXT-Remediation.ps1 — safely fix a missing or mis-scoped iOS SSO app-extension profile
    • IOSSSOEXT-Report.ps1 — SSO coverage report for iOS/iPadOS devices (app-extension applied or not)
    • IOSSSOEXT-Set-ScopeTargeting.ps1 — set the target group for the iOS SSO app-extension profile
    • IOSSSOEXT-Validation.ps1 — validate assignment and per-device applied state of the SSO app extension

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
